title: The Grave Goods
text: A barrow opened by robbers and left half looted, its door kicked in, its dead dragged from their rest. Muddy bootprints go in and do not all come out. The best of the grave goods are still down there in the dark, with whatever stopped the robbers.

options.label: Take what the robbers left. It would be a waste to leave it.

outcomes.text: You take the old gold while the dead watch.
The dead want it back. They are what stopped the robbers.

options.label: The devout reseals the barrow, and lays the dead back to rest.

outcomes.text: The dead lie down again, grateful. Something of their peace goes with you.

options.label: The sharpest tracks the robbers, and the loot they did get away with.

outcomes.text: The trail leads to their camp, where the loot waits along with their knives.
